rounds.text: Cosmo First Ltd carries a severe valuation disconnect, with a discounted cash flow model placing intrinsic value at ₹446 per share against a market price of ₹904, resulting in a negative margin of safety of -102.6% [E45, E46]. The reverse DCF indicates that today's price already demands a 9.8% earnings growth rate, which starkly contrasts with a historical 10-year compounded profit growth of 0% and a 5-year contraction of -13% [E18, E19, E47]. Underlying structural returns remain lacklustre, highlighted by a low 3-year median return on equity of 6% and a recent ROCE of 9.6%, which significantly underperforms the sector median ROCE of 13.4% [E12, E28, E76]. Balance sheet leverage presents a tangible risk, as borrowings expanded to ₹1,573 Cr and the debt-to-equity ratio reached 1.20x, alongside explicit flags for a low interest coverage ratio and earnings containing ₹99.9 Cr of other income [E39, E59, E62]. Furthermore, insider confidence is waning as promoter holdings dropped by 4.26 percentage points to 40.78% since Sep 2023, while foreign institutional ownership also declined [E41, E42]. Conceded: [E17, E21, E35, E36, E50, E51, E66, E68].
